card.name: Mixed words before a likely word ending
card.fires_on: Words in general web text that are cut off or lead into a known continuation, such as procrast before ination, superst before ition, or Auckland after University of. It also fires on harsh adjectives like militant, ruthless and egregious after more or most.

modes.label: Cut-off long words
modes.description: The first part of a long word whose ending is nearly certain.
modes.example: it would be very easy for to resume your<< procrast>>ination.

modes.label: Strong negative adjectives
modes.description: Intense adjectives after more, most or actually that describe harsh people or acts.
modes.example: were actually<< militant>> revolutionaries and perverters of Christian

modes.label: Place names
modes.description: Place names such as Auckland or France after university or location phrases.
modes.example: of the University of<< Auckland>>. The study involved 85 healthy
